diff --git a/Solidity/Frontend/Testing.lean b/Solidity/Frontend/Testing.lean
index 07f912bd..c6aac009 100644
--- a/Solidity/Frontend/Testing.lean
+++ b/Solidity/Frontend/Testing.lean
@@ -184,6 +184,19 @@ def testOrdinaryTree (N : Lean.Name) (φ : Expr) : TermElabM Bool := do
   if ← hasCallRec N (← Symex.evaluable φ) then return false
   return !(← callsBackE N φ)
 
+/-- Retain only the selected program for native evaluation. The formula spine
+and its binders stay visible, and callers classify the original formula first.
+No result is reused across environments: the safe declaration is this import's
+exact kernel-checked program, compiled in the current command environment. -/
+private def retainedProgram (f : Lean.Name) (problem : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
+  let original ← Symex.evaluable problem
+  let info ← getConstInfo f
+  let some value := info.value? | return original
+  unless info.type.isAppOfArity ``Prog 3 do return original
+  if value.hasMVar || value.hasFVar || value.hasLooseBVars then return original
+  if (IR.findEnvDecl (← getEnv) f).isNone then compileDecls #[f]
+  return original.replace fun e => if e == value then some (mkConst f) else none
+
 /-- Test one imported obligation. Search constructs a proof term; `addDecl`
 checks it in the kernel before it can be reported as proved. Open goals are
 pending; budget exhaustion is an error. Neither is evidence a claim is false. -/
@@ -272,6 +285,7 @@ def testObligation (N : Lean.Name) (r : ImportRow) (tail : TailMode := .solc)
       let mode : TailMode := if tail == .clean && spec?.isNone && !cb then .clean else .solc
       modeRef.set mode
       let problem := mkConst (f ++ `problem)
+      let prepared ← if spec?.isNone then retainedProgram f problem else pure obligation
